findings.evidence: The declaration states `H' ∈ MulAction.orbit (ConjAct G) H ↔ ...`; unlike `IntermediateField.mem_conjugateFields_iff` at line 77 of `IntermediateField/ConjugateFields.lean`, there is no corresponding `conjugateSubgroups` definition.
